action: Perry Local families and staff: follow district notices and be alert to phishing that mentions the school closure. Other districts: confirm offline backups and incident contacts.
exec: A school district closed for a day after an IT incident, a reminder that school systems are routine targets.
impact: All district school buildings closed on November 16 and reopened November 17; internet and some technology stayed limited, phone system restored.
plain: Perry Local Schools in Ohio closed for a day after a cyber incident hit its computer systems. Classes resumed the next day.
summary: Perry Local Schools in Stark County, Ohio closed all buildings on November 16 after what it called a cyber incident affecting technology, internet and communication systems. Schools reopened November 17 with internet and some technology still limited. The district notified Perry Township police. A Canton Repository headline attributes the incident to malware; its text was not readable. No data theft or ransom is reported.
title: Perry Local Schools (Ohio) closes after cyber incident hits IT systems

validation.note: News 5 Cleveland and Cleveland 19 read; the malware cause comes from a Canton Repository headline only (page blocked).

review.note: Compared with News 5 Cleveland and Cleveland 19: closure Nov 16, reopening Nov 17, limited internet, phone restored, police notified. Malware cause correctly marked as unverified.
